cs.t: I have been using that Staedtler pencil for almost three years. I absolutely love it. I think I'm on only my third or forth nib. I've used it with Note and S Ultra devices, and a Boox E-ink device.

cs.t: As a fellow EMR stylus enjoyer, which one do you prefer the most? The thin one in the phones tends to be too small to use comfortably and the one that comes with the Galaxy Book/tablets is decent (but the Galaxy Book has very inconsistent support for the buttons). The Wacom One stylus used to be my favorite, but lately I've been enjoying using the Kindle Scribe stylus/the fat Staedler stylus (I think they're both very similar in usage experience).

cs.t: I have a box of 120 Blackwing pencils of all types. They look nice, expensive, but a bad tool. (review ->  https://www.instagram.com/p/CrD5KRnuLnh/?img_index=2&igsh=cD...  ) They are not suitable for fine drawing (too waxy and soft) - those are either STAEDTLER, FaberCastell, or Tombow (Japanese brand). The fancy tip eraser is also not very useful. The metal around it is so soft, it can't hold any pressure. Also extremely not child friendly, as the small metal part inside just fells out. Tombow Mono - de-facto standard eraser.
